INSERT INTO agent_decisions (
  conversation_id, estado_entrada, intent,
  trigger_handoff, trigger_loss, response_text, model_used,
  price_suppressed_reason
)

  conv.id,
  COALESCE(conv.estado::text, 'UNKNOWN'),
  CASE
    WHEN $1::boolean THEN 'interes_producto'
    WHEN $2::boolean THEN 'rechazo'
    ELSE 'conversacion'

  $1::boolean,
  $2::boolean,
  SUBSTRING($3, 1, 500),
  $5,
  NULLIF($6, '')
FROM conversaciones conv
WHERE conv.chatwoot_conv_id = $4::int
LIMIT 1;

=SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
SELECT upsert_chatwoot_ids('{{ $json.conv_id }}'::uuid, {{ $json.chatwoot_contact_id }}::integer, {{ $json.chatwoot_conv_id }}::integer)

=SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
INSERT INTO eventos_conversacion (conversation_id, tipo_evento, actor, payload) VALUES ('{{ $json.conv_id }}'::uuid, '{{ $json.evento_tipo }}', 'sistema', '{{ $json.evento_payload }}')

SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
WITH input AS (
  SELECT
    $1::text AS phone,
    CASE WHEN $2::text ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN $2::integer END AS cw_conv_id,
    CASE WHEN $3::text ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN $3::integer END AS cw_contact_id
)
SELECT
  lm.id AS mem_id,
  lm.phone,
  lm.conversation_id,
  COALESCE(lm.conversation_state, 'NEW_LEAD') AS conversation_state,
  COALESCE(lm.summary, '') AS summary,
  COALESCE(lm.turn_count, 0) AS turn_count,
  lm.followup_at,
  lm.contact_sent_at,
  lm.chatwoot_conv_id,
  lm.chatwoot_contact_id,
       lm.last_inbound_message_at,
       COALESCE(lm.source, 'outbound') AS source,
  lm.gps_previo,
  lm.problema_principal,
  lm.decision_maker,
  lm.ultima_pregunta_campo,
  lm.ultima_pregunta,
  lm.selected_plan,
  lm.selected_plan_name,
  lm.selected_plan_price,
  lm.selected_plan_duration,
  lm.last_response_type,
  (to_jsonb(lm)->>'loss_reason_code') AS loss_reason_code,
  (to_jsonb(lm)->>'loss_reason_comment') AS loss_reason_comment,
  (to_jsonb(lm)->>'conversation_closed_reason') AS conversation_closed_reason,
  COALESCE((to_jsonb(lm)->>'plan_reopen_count')::integer, 0) AS plan_reopen_count,
  COALESCE(c.automation_enabled, true) AS automation_enabled,
  COALESCE(c.human_handoff, false) AS human_handoff
FROM lead_memory lm
CROSS JOIN input i
LEFT JOIN conversaciones c ON c.id = lm.conversation_id
WHERE lm.phone = i.phone
   OR lm.phone = '+' || i.phone
   OR (i.cw_conv_id IS NOT NULL AND lm.chatwoot_conv_id = i.cw_conv_id)
   OR (i.cw_contact_id IS NOT NULL AND lm.chatwoot_contact_id = i.cw_contact_id)
ORDER BY CASE
  WHEN lm.phone = i.phone OR lm.phone = '+' || i.phone THEN 0
  WHEN i.cw_conv_id IS NOT NULL AND lm.chatwoot_conv_id = i.cw_conv_id THEN 1
  ELSE 2
END, lm.updated_at DESC
LIMIT 1

SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
WITH updated_memory AS (
  UPDATE lead_memory SET
    conversation_state = COALESCE(NULLIF($2, ''), conversation_state),
    asesor_requerido   = CASE WHEN $3::boolean THEN TRUE ELSE asesor_requerido END,
    chatwoot_conv_id   = COALESCE($4::integer, chatwoot_conv_id),
    chatwoot_contact_id= COALESCE($5::integer, chatwoot_contact_id),
    gps_previo         = COALESCE(NULLIF($6, ''), gps_previo),
    problema_principal = COALESCE(NULLIF($7, ''), problema_principal),
    decision_maker     = COALESCE(NULLIF($8, ''), decision_maker),
    ultima_pregunta    = COALESCE(NULLIF($9, ''), ultima_pregunta),
    ultima_pregunta_campo = COALESCE(NULLIF($10, ''), ultima_pregunta_campo),
    summary            = COALESCE(NULLIF($11, ''), summary),
    selected_plan      = COALESCE(NULLIF($12, ''), selected_plan),
    selected_plan_name = COALESCE(NULLIF($13, ''), selected_plan_name),
    selected_plan_price = COALESCE($14::numeric, selected_plan_price),
    selected_plan_duration = COALESCE($15::integer, selected_plan_duration),
    last_response_type = COALESCE(NULLIF($16, ''), last_response_type),
    turn_count         = turn_count + 1,
    last_message_at    = NOW(),
    plan_reopen_count  = COALESCE($17::integer, plan_reopen_count)
  WHERE phone = $1 OR phone = '+' || $1
  RETURNING phone, conversation_id, conversation_state, turn_count, gps_previo, problema_principal, decision_maker, summary, selected_plan, last_response_type
), valid_state AS (
  SELECT um.*
  FROM updated_memory um
  WHERE um.conversation_id IS NOT NULL
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM pg_enum e
      WHERE e.enumtypid = 'estado_conversacion'::regtype
        AND e.enumlabel = um.conversation_state
    )
), state_result AS (
  SELECT sr.*
  FROM valid_state vs
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL set_conversation_state(
    vs.conversation_id,
    vs.conversation_state,
    'cris_inbound_mem2',
    jsonb_build_object('phone', vs.phone, 'last_response_type', vs.last_response_type)
  ) sr
), reconciled_memory AS (
  UPDATE lead_memory lm
  SET conversation_state = sr.old_state,
      updated_at = NOW()
  FROM updated_memory um
  JOIN state_result sr ON sr.conversation_id = um.conversation_id
  WHERE lm.phone = um.phone
    AND sr.changed = false
    AND sr.reason = 'transition_not_allowed'
  RETURNING lm.phone, lm.conversation_state
), touched_conversation AS (
  UPDATE conversaciones c
  SET ultima_respuesta_at = NOW(),
      updated_at = NOW()
  FROM state_result sr
  WHERE c.id = sr.conversation_id
    AND sr.reason = 'no_change'
  RETURNING c.id, c.estado
)
SELECT
  um.phone,
  COALESCE(rm.conversation_state, um.conversation_state) AS conversation_state,
  um.turn_count,
  um.gps_previo,
  um.problema_principal,
  um.decision_maker,
  um.summary,
  um.selected_plan,
  um.last_response_type,
  COALESCE(tc.estado::text, sr.new_state, sr.old_state) AS conversation_estado,
  sr.reason AS state_transition_reason
FROM updated_memory um
LEFT JOIN state_result sr ON sr.conversation_id = um.conversation_id
LEFT JOIN touched_conversation tc ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN reconciled_memory rm ON rm.phone = um.phone

SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
WITH touched AS (
  SELECT touch_last_inbound_message($1::text, $2::text) AS last_inbound_message_at
)
SELECT
  get_conversation_window() AS window_minutes,
  get_system_config_bool('testing_mode') AS testing_mode,
  get_system_config_text('conversation_window_minutes') AS conversation_window_minutes,
  t.last_inbound_message_at,
  evaluate_conversation_window(t.last_inbound_message_at) AS window_eval
FROM touched t;

SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
WITH input AS (
  SELECT
    $1::text AS phone,
    CASE WHEN $2::text ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN $2::integer END AS cw_conv_id,
    CASE WHEN $3::text ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN $3::integer END AS cw_contact_id
), existing AS (
  SELECT lm.id
  FROM lead_memory lm, input i
  WHERE lm.phone = i.phone
     OR lm.phone = '+' || i.phone
     OR (i.cw_conv_id IS NOT NULL AND lm.chatwoot_conv_id = i.cw_conv_id)
     OR (i.cw_contact_id IS NOT NULL AND lm.chatwoot_contact_id = i.cw_contact_id)
  ORDER BY CASE
    WHEN lm.phone = i.phone OR lm.phone = '+' || i.phone THEN 0
    WHEN i.cw_conv_id IS NOT NULL AND lm.chatwoot_conv_id = i.cw_conv_id THEN 1
    ELSE 2
  END, lm.updated_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
), updated AS (
  UPDATE lead_memory lm
  SET source = CASE WHEN lm.source = 'outbound' THEN lm.source ELSE 'inbound_cold' END,
      chatwoot_conv_id = COALESCE(i.cw_conv_id, lm.chatwoot_conv_id),
      chatwoot_contact_id = COALESCE(i.cw_contact_id, lm.chatwoot_contact_id),
      updated_at = NOW()
  FROM existing e, input i
  WHERE lm.id = e.id
  RETURNING lm.id, lm.phone, lm.conversation_state, lm.chatwoot_conv_id, lm.chatwoot_contact_id
), inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO lead_memory (phone, conversation_state, source, chatwoot_conv_id, chatwoot_contact_id)
  SELECT i.phone, 'NEW_LEAD', 'inbound_cold', i.cw_conv_id, i.cw_contact_id
  FROM input i
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing)
  RETURNING id, phone, conversation_state, chatwoot_conv_id, chatwoot_contact_id
)
SELECT * FROM updated
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM inserted

parameters.content:
## B00 - Como leer el Master

Flujo principal de izquierda a derecha: entrada -> ventana -> normalizacion -> buffer/prompt -> contexto -> botones/lead -> gates -> IA -> respuesta -> acciones comerciales.

Filas inferiores: followups, sincronizacion Chatwoot/WF09 y utilidades manuales.

Regla de lectura: las notas explican el proposito; las conexiones n8n siguen siendo la fuente exacta de ejecucion.

nodes.name: NOTE B00 - Como leer el Master

parameters.content:
## B01 - Ingesta Chatwoot

Que hace: recibe el webhook de Chatwoot/WhatsApp y filtra eventos.
Entrada: message_created desde Chatwoot.
Salida: payload base en Edit Fields.
Nota: mensajes salientes y notas privadas terminan aqui; no deben despertar la IA.

## B02 - Ventana conversacional

Que hace: actualiza last inbound, evalua si la conversacion sigue dentro de ventana y deja trazabilidad.
Entrada: mensaje entrante valido.
Salida: contexto restaurado para procesar o rama detenida si la ventana expiro.
Nota: los nodos WIN tambien aplican labels/notas operativas.

## B03 - Normalizacion multimedia

Que hace: convierte texto, audio, imagen o ubicacion en un mensaje comun.
Entrada: payload filtrado por ventana.
Salida: content_text/type normalizado.
Nota: audio se transcribe, imagen se analiza y ubicacion se formatea antes de unificar.

## B04 - Buffer, debounce y prompt

Que hace: agrupa mensajes consecutivos con Redis, espera 9s cuando hace falta y carga/cachea el system prompt.
Entrada: mensaje normalizado.
Salida: mensaje concatenado + prompt disponible.
Nota: evita respuestas fragmentadas cuando el cliente manda varios mensajes seguidos.

nodes.name: NOTE B04 - Buffer, debounce y prompt

parameters.content:
## B05 - Contexto y memoria

Que hace: consulta Chatwoot y memoria del lead antes de decidir.
Entrada: mensaje final del buffer.
Salida: datos de contacto, lead memory y contexto historico.
Nota: este bloque prepara el terreno para botones, lead inbound y gates.

## B06 - Botones y lead inbound

Que hace: procesa botones deterministas y onboarding inbound antes de llamar a la IA.
Entrada: contexto + memoria.
Salida: plan seleccionado, razon de perdida, handoff o lead actualizado.
Nota: botones de plan/loss/handoff tienen prioridad para evitar interpretaciones ambiguas del LLM.

nodes.name: NOTE B06 - Botones y lead inbound

parameters.content:
## B07 - Gates de estado y TAC

Que hace: decide si la IA puede responder.
Entrada: contexto enriquecido.
Salida: pasa al agente, envia aviso TAC o apaga IA por takeover humano.
Nota: aqui viven agent_status, consentimiento, rechazo explicito, tags conversacionales y takeover humano.

nodes.name: NOTE B07 - Gates de estado y TAC

parameters.content:
## B08 - Core AI Agent

Que hace: CRIS decide intencion, respuesta, next_state y acciones sugeridas.
Entrada: mensaje + contexto + memoria + prompt.
Salida: objeto estructurado para respuesta y side effects.
Nota: usa LLM principal/secundario, memoria, calculadora, think, MCP y parser/fallback.

## B09 - Composer y delivery

Que hace: transforma la respuesta en mensajes naturales y los envia.
Entrada: respuesta del agente o segmentos deterministas.
Salida: texto/adjuntos enviados con typing y delay.
Nota: separa el contenido conversacional del transporte WhatsApp/Chatwoot.

## B10 - CSE Business Actions

Que hace: ejecuta efectos comerciales derivados de la decision IA.
Entrada: salida estructurada del agente.
Salida: memoria actualizada, pricing/FAQ, handoff, perdida, descuento, labels y mensajes CSE.
Nota: aqui se separan side effects comerciales del envio principal al cliente.

## B11 — Followups programados (SECCIÓN ELIMINADA 2026-07-16)

Los 24 nodos legacy de followups que vivían aquí eran inalcanzables desde
cualquier trigger y duplicaban CRIS-02 — FollowUp Scheduler.

La lógica real vive en:
- CRIS-02 (CRON 3min) + claim_due_followups() [V85/V120]
- pause_outbound_for_customer_engagement() [V86/V90]
- expire_pending_loss_reasons() [V125]

Backup previo: workflows/backups/*-before-fase3-*. Plan: docs/PLAN-MEJORA-CRIS-2026-07-16.md

## B12 - Sync Chatwoot y WF09 tags

Que hace: reconcilia IDs de Chatwoot y sincroniza labels/tags operativos.
Entrada: pendientes de sync o eventos de estado.
Salida: contacto/conversacion vinculados y tags aplicados.
Nota: F1 CRON aparece deshabilitado en este export; revisar antes de activar.

nodes.name: NOTE B12 - Sync Chatwoot y WF09 tags

parameters.content:
## B13 - Utilidades manuales

Que hace: mantenimiento manual de cache/prompt Redis.
Entrada: ejecucion manual o listado de keys.
Salida: prompt/cache eliminado cuando se requiere refresh.
Nota: no es parte del happy path productivo; mantener separado para no confundir demos.
